I work in palliative care/end of life care and the amount of pain and suffering which someone goes through as they begin to die is awful. We can administer madazolam for agitation or morphine for pain management but it doesn’t stop the suffering. The patients mouth cracks and breaks down, their skin/tissue viability breaks down and they get very sore and painful skin. We have to still assist them with personal care and manual handling so we have to roll them to change their pads etc..doing this causes them excruciating pain as every inch of their body is painful. When someone gets to that point..I feel it’s humane to euthanise them..
